gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2018 gross claims outstanding were GBP 590.161m. During 2018 the Syndicate recorded adverse prior-year development of GBP 80.521m (gross), representing a strengthening of reserves (c.13.6% of opening gross claims). The movement reflects adverse development arising from large/complex losses and catastrophe-related activity, while the balance sheet was also materially affected by the prior-year external reinsurance-to-close of 2015 & prior (a significant release shown separately). Named 2018 events for which reserves were established include Hurricanes Florence and Michael and Californian wildfires.
